description: I am responsible to CSC for the safe and efficient conduct of all SCC activities within the Area.
I deputise for the AO and monitor issue and custody of MoD boats, weapons, ammunition and training funds.
I'm responsible for providing business and management support directly to Unit Management Teams (UMT).
I process and record all the paperwork that comes through the Area.
I provide financial advice and keep the Area's Account Books in good order.
I am responsible for ensuring that units and equipment are safe for CFAVs, cadets and visitors to use.
I encourage, support, develop and deliver all training in the Area through ASOs and external organisations.
I am the most senior volunteer in the Area. I act in the interests of the CFAVs within the Area.
I organise, encourage, support and safely deliver all competitions held in the Area.
I assist units in the recruitment and retention of CFAVs and cadets.
I represent Chairmen of the units in the Area, so their views and concerns are well represented.
I am the Senior Staff Officer's (SSO) principal adviser and assistant on all Area matters concerning SR/NCO Volunteers.
I ensure that SCC policies are applied in the Company to ensure RMC Detachments maintain high standards.
